info.title: T3 Log Backend API
info.description:
API layer for T3 Log: mentorship workflows, tasks, and server-side notifications.

Email notifications are sent server-side via Resend. Frontend should never ship or access RESEND_API_KEY.

get.description:
Health check endpoint.

Returns:
    JSON payload indicating service is alive.

post.summary: Send email to mentor when intern submits a task update
post.description: Looks up mentor and intern recipients via Supabase and sends a notification email via Resend. Requires RESEND_API_KEY, SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY.

post.summary: Send email to intern when mentor updates task status/remarks
post.description: Looks up mentor and intern recipients via Supabase and sends a notification email via Resend. Requires RESEND_API_KEY, SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY.

Core server-side route to send a single email using Resend. Uses server-side RESEND_API_KEY only (frontend must never access it). Subject line should follow: 'T3 Log Update: [Action Name]'. Requires RESEND_API_KEY (or legacy RESEND_API-KEY) and RESEND_FROM_EMAIL.
